change_summary: App-only successor to v101.47. Carries forward the FINDING-01 service-worker precache fix and the mobile Note button. NEW: recovery for stale text highlights. A highlight is anchored to (paragraph id, character offsets, text_hash), so editorial work silently breaks it - one changed character makes text_hash mismatch and the highlight stops being drawn, and a merged paragraph makes it unreachable, leaving an entry in Mon Espace that could not be removed. On load, stale records are re-anchored by locating the stored passage text unambiguously in the current corpus (normalised comparison; a whole-snapshot match must be unique, or for long snapshots both ends must be unique with a length sanity check), and multi-paragraph selections whose target disappeared are moved to a surviving sibling of the same selection only. Ambiguous and short matches are refused rather than guessed; nothing is deleted automatically. Records that cannot be recovered are now listed in Mon Espace with a working Retirer button instead of being invisible or unremovable. Measured against a real 56-highlight production export: 38 anchored cleanly, 15 recovered, 3 left for the user to decide, 2 of which already fail to render on the current production build. Corpus unchanged.
